content:
“You aren't afraid to dig a little deeper to get what you want.”

**Butcher's Bounty** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increasing chance to find extra meat when searching a creature corpse.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | 80% chance to find extra meat from animal corpses. | 00187429 | 
| ★★ | 2 | 60% chance to find extra meat from animal corpses. | 00187426 | 
| ★ | 1 | 40% chance to find extra meat from animal corpses. | 0018731F | 

- Butcher's Bounty will not retroactively find meat if equipped after the creature is killed.
- Bloodbug meat may only be found on bloodbugs with the Butcher's Bounty perk.
